description.value: Summit Lake Resort is a seasonal lakeside resort on the continental divide between the Pacific and Arctic watersheds, set 50 km north of Prince George just off the Alaska Highway. The resort offers RV and tent sites, rental cabins (double occupancy, no washrooms), a boat launch, and picnic facilities on a lake with over 40 km of undeveloped shoreline. Nearby attractions include Teapot Mountain hiking trails and the historic Giscome Portage Trail, making it a scenic stop for touring cyclists on the Highway 97 corridor.
